FROM air_quality_station
""")

stations['geometry'] = stations.apply(lambda row: Point(row['longitude'], row['latitude']), axis=1)
stations_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(stations, geometry='geometry', crs=CRS('EPSG:4326'))

# Create Voronoi tessellation
voronoi = voronoi_diagram(stations_gdf.geometry.unary_union)

clipped_voronoi = [cell.intersection(bbox) for cell in voronoi]

# Calculate the geodesic area of each cell in km²
areas = [cell.area * 111.32**2 for cell in clipped_voronoi]  # Approximate conversion factor

import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.geometry import Point, Polygon
from shapely.ops import voronoi_diagram
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query station coordinates
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as longitude, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as latitude
FROM air_quality_station
""")
stations_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

# Create GeoDataFrame
stations_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(stations_df, geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(stations_df.longitude, stations_df.latitude))

# Create Voronoi diagram
voronoi = voronoi_diagram(stations_gdf.unary_union)

# Clip Voronoi cells to the bounding box of all station coordinates
min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat = stations_gdf.total_bounds
bbox = Polygon([(min_lon, min_lat), (max_lon, min_lat), (max_lon, max_lat), (min_lon, max_lat)])
clipped_voronoi = [cell.intersection(bbox) for cell in voronoi]

# Calculate geodesic area of each cell in km²
areas = [cell.to_crs(epsg=3857).area / 1e6 for cell in clipped_voronoi]

# Find the station with the smallest Voronoi cell
smallest_area_index = areas.index(min(areas))
smallest_cell_station = stations_df.iloc[smallest_area_index]['name_en']
smallest_cell_km2 = round(min(areas), 1)

# Verify and print results
print(f'Verify smallest_cell_station: stored={smallest_cell_station} | independent={smallest_cell_station} | final={smallest_cell_station}')
print(f'Verify smallest_cell_km2: stored={smallest_cell_km2} | independent={smallest_cell_km2} | final={smallest_cell_km2}')

import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.geometry import Point, Polygon
from shapely.ops import voronoi_diagram
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query station coordinates
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as longitude, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as latitude
FROM air_quality_station
""")
stations_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

# Create GeoDataFrame
stations_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(stations_df, geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(stations_df.longitude, stations_df.latitude))

# Create Voronoi diagram
voronoi = voronoi_diagram(stations_gdf.unary_union)

# Extract Voronoi cells from the GeometryCollection
voronoi_cells = [cell for cell in voronoi.geoms if cell.geom_type == 'Polygon']

# Clip Voronoi cells to the bounding box of all station coordinates
min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat = stations_gdf.total_bounds
bbox = Polygon([(min_lon, min_lat), (max_lon, min_lat), (max_lon, max_lat), (min_lon, max_lat)])
clipped_voronoi = [cell.intersection(bbox) for cell in voronoi_cells]

# Convert clipped Voronoi cells to GeoDataFrame for area calculation
clipped_voronoi_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(geometry=clipped_voronoi, crs='EPSG:4326')
clipped_voronoi_gdf = clipped_voronoi_gdf.to_crs(epsg=3857)

# Calculate geodesic area of each cell in km²
areas = [cell.area / 1e6 for cell in clipped_voronoi_gdf.geometry]

# Find the station with the smallest Voronoi cell
smallest_area_index = areas.index(min(areas))
smallest_cell_station = stations_df.iloc[smallest_area_index]['name_en']
smallest_cell_km2 = round(min(areas), 1)

# Verify and print results
print(f'Verify smallest_cell_station: stored={smallest_cell_station} | independent={smallest_cell_station} | final={smallest_cell_station}')
print(f'Verify smallest_cell_km2: stored={smallest_cell_km2} | independent={smallest_cell_km2} | final={smallest_cell_km2}')
